summary.t: A cloud with the name and everything about the day your baby was born

text.t:
Delicate and timeless, this pine plywood cloud preserves the most precious details of your baby's birth. The name, in raised plywood, brings the piece to life, while the birth date, time, and length at birth are laser-engraved to eternalise every detail of this special moment.
With delicate shapes and natural cotton thread to hang the piece, it is a piece created to decorate with love and to keep the magic of the first day forever.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: Always hang out of reach of the baby — above or outside the cot, never inside it: the cord can tangle. Check from time to time that it remains securely fastened.
